goal: prove or falsify one shared AssetGraph decoder/postprocess path from native RTMDet-R and ONNX Runtime tensors to final canonical RawDetection records

input.preprocess: BGR resize to 1024x1024 then frozen mean/std normalization

shared_adapter.boundary: nine raw RTMDet-R tensors to AssetGraph canonical RawDetection records
shared_adapter.decoder: MMRotate RotatedRTMDetHead.predict_by_feat at the frozen source commit

measurement_repair.trigger: the first frozen run produced identical final counts and per-class counts with parameter deltas below 0.00015, but greedy global IoU matching was non-bijective in dense same-class clusters and left 27 of 201 detections unmatched
measurement_repair.correction: sort canonically by class and geometry, pair the already count-locked records bijectively, and compute rotated IoU with an independent float64 convex-polygon implementation

non_goals: no DOTA weights promoted as product perception weights
no claim of UAV-OBB or TRANSSET accuracy
no claim that MMRotate postprocess is the final lightweight production implementation
next_if_pass: promote the canonical detection contract and Apache ONNX adapter boundary into AssetGraph Core, then start lawful multi-domain intake/training without opening TRANSSET-H01
